correctness.rationale: The two hypotheses, evaluated at each binary invertible linear substitution g, annihilate the left-composed rows e_g+e_{Cg} and e_g+e_{Ag}+e_{A²g}. I independently enumerated GL(3,2) as permutations of the binary vectors from all ordered bases, used conventional composition, and checked rank 160 and all 168 swap inclusions with explicit reconstructed row witnesses; the identity swap witness used 84 input rows. The frozen code's compose(g,h) in ordinary matrix order evaluates h after g, so its calls with the generator first actually form right-composed rows. Inversion of group indices carries these to the required left-composed span (C is inverted but gives the same pair rows up to translation, the A norm is invariant under inversion, and S is an involution). The independent replay verifies the required order directly. Evaluation is F₂-linear into the polynomial module, so the universal vector identity needs no assumption of homogeneity, finite degree bound, domain, or field among coefficient algebras.
residual_risks: Exact binary calculation, not a Lean proof; no characteristic other than two is inferred.
